title: Lead sprint sync & action capture — 2026-12-01
content:
Quick summary: Shorter standup-style review today focused on three cross-cutting risks: EU capacity headroom for Q1 customers, quantization rollout risk after last-minute regression in hallucination rate, and trace sampling blind spots for long-lived KV cache hits. Decided to pause one non-critical rollout and to run an accelerated eval and chaos test path this sprint.

Agenda:
- 10m: Capacity run-rate & EU region concerns (Priya, Marco)
- 15m: Quantization rollout status and QA regression (Marco, Research/MLOps)
- 10m: Observability gaps: trace sampling & cost tagging (Sofia)
- 10m: SRE/chaos plan for fallback policies (Ethan)
- 5m: Action items and owners

Notes and decisions: 
1) EU Dedicated capacity: observed 18% headroom reduction on nightly traffic due to two new enterprise customers routing spikes (see perf report). Decision: provision temporary burst pool (1x A100 equivalent) tied to dedicated-qa account for the next 4 weeks while we complete autoscaler policy tuning. Priya to draft customer communication and cost estimate; budget approval path with finance next week.
- Rationale: preserves SLA while we tune autoscaling thresholds instead of shifting customers to lower latency regions.

2) Quantization rollout (qprofile-v2): after canary yesterday, we saw a small but significant uptick in hallucination score on prompt-set 'customer-helpdesk-rotations' (regression +4.7% on intent accuracy). Decision: pause public rollout of qprofile-v2 for hosted API and Dedicated; keep internal A/B test for controlled evals.
- Immediate next step: run expanded eval suite across 6 prompts sets + human-review sample. Marco to own re-run; target re-eval by 2026-12-06. See ticket SERVE-2310.

3) Observability / sampling blind spot: long-running KV cache hits are being downsampled by current trace sampler; this is hiding costly prefix-cache misses that correlate with latency spikes. Decision: increase trace sampling for requests with cache-miss flag for 72 hours and add a high-cardinality tag to traces for model-variant + cache-state. Sofia will implement config change and post-delta dashboard tiles.

4) SRE chaos & fallback test: planned canary rollback paths haven't been exercised end-to-end. Action: run a scheduled chaos run next Thursday 2026-12-08 to exercise fallback routing, model-variant failover, and autoscaler cooldown. Ethan to coordinate with Platform Eng, Serving Runtime, and CS on a limited blast radius.

5) Rollout gating and communications: until qprofile-v2 passes extended eval, change internal rollout policy: require both A/B metric parity (<=1.5% delta) across core evals and human-sampled quality signoff. Aisha to update rollout playbook and notify product/legal.

Open blockers / risks flagged: 
- Constrained EU GPU capacity if 2 more enterprise trials onboard in January (mitigation: procurement, temp burst pool).
- Quantization regression source unknown (model conversion pipeline vs kernel selection) — needs deep-dive from runtime and applied-ml.
- Billing metering discrepancy reported by finance for dedicated accounts (PLAT-1423) — priority triage scheduled with billing infra.

Action items (owner — due date — notes):
- Priya Menon — 2026-12-04 — Provision temporary EU burst pool and prepare cost write-up; link to finance thread (JIRA:PLAT-1423).
- Marco Liu — 2026-12-06 — Re-run extended eval for qprofile-v2 and isolate regression vectors; attach comparison table to SERVE-2310.
- Sofia Ramirez — 2026-12-03 — Implement trace sampling override for cache-miss requests + dashboard tiles; add alert if cache-miss rate spikes >5%.
- Ethan Brooks — 2026-12-08 — Execute chaos/fallback run; runbook and blast-radius doc to be posted in Confluence prior to test.
- Aisha Patel — 2026-12-02 — Update rollout playbook and send note to product/legal/ops.
- Security follow-up: Tomás to validate that increased tracing is compliant with PII policy; report by 2026-12-03.

Parking lot (short notes / follow-ups):
- Investigate automated prompt-set augmentation for eval coverage (R&D spike).
- Revisit autoscaler cooldown defaults after chaos test.
- Consider a 'burst left' dashboard widget for real-time capacity headroom.

Meeting cadence & logistics:
- Keep weekly lead sync at Tuesday 10:00 PT for December; next meeting 2026-12-08 will be shortened to 45m due to holiday prep.
- Please update the Confluence note with completed action items and link to PRs/Jira when closing items.

Quick notes to self (informal):
- Marco: watch kernel selection logs closely — last time the kernel fallback path correlated with a tiny output distribution shift.
- Sofia: add a temporary debug tag to sampling config to ease rollback.
- Priya: check sales ops for customer onboarding dates — urgency varies.

Referenced tickets and artifacts: SERVE-2310 (quantization canary), PLAT-1423 (billing metering), PR runtime#487 (perf fix candidate), confluence/sprint plan doc.

End of notes — capture made by Aisha; will convert to canonical action register and post in Confluence under /engineering/platform/actions. Reach out in #lead-sync if anything needs urgent escalation.
